steps.en: Install the pack once into your coding agent
steps.zh: 一次性把技能包装进你的 coding agent

steps.en: Define the work with the lifecycle command
steps.zh: 用生命周期命令定义需求

steps.en: Routes to spec-driven-development and forces a PRD before any code
steps.zh: 路由到 spec-driven-development，先写 PRD 再写代码

steps.en: Walk the rest of the lifecycle command by command
steps.zh: 沿生命周期逐条命令推进

steps.en: Each command activates the right skills: TDD, five-axis review, security, launch gates
steps.zh: 每条命令自动激活对应技能：TDD、五轴评审、安全、发布闸门

steps.en: Every skill ends in evidence requirements, with anti-rationalization tables closing escape hatches
steps.zh: 技能以证据要求收尾，反驳表堵住找理由跳步

value.en: Senior-engineer discipline - spec, tests, review, launch gates - firing on every task instead of only when you remember to ask
value.zh: 资深工程师纪律——spec、测试、评审、发布闸门——在每个任务上自动生效，而不是靠你想起来提醒
